# superset_chart (Resource)

Manages a chart (slice) in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_chart" "example" {
  slice_name      = "Revenue by Region"
  datasource_id   = superset_dataset.sales.id
  datasource_type = "table"
  viz_type        = "pie"
  description     = "Pie chart showing revenue distribution by region"
}
```

### Chart with Cache Timeout

```terraform
resource "superset_chart" "cached_chart" {
  slice_name      = "Daily Active Users"
  datasource_id   = superset_dataset.analytics.id
  datasource_type = "table"
  viz_type        = "big_number_total"
  description     = "Total daily active users with 5-minute cache"
  cache_timeout   = 300
}
```

### Minimal Chart (Required Fields Only)

```terraform
resource "superset_chart" "minimal" {
  slice_name    = "Simple Table"
  datasource_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datasource_id` (Number) The ID of the dataset/datasource this chart uses.
- `slice_name` (String) The name of the chart.

### Optional

- `cache_timeout` (Number) Duration (in seconds) of the caching timeout for this chart.
- `certification_details` (String) Details of the certification.
- `certified_by` (String) Person or group that has certified this chart.
- `dashboards` (List of Number) List of dashboard IDs that this chart belongs to. Adding a dashboard ID here will link the chart to that dashboard.
- `datasource_type` (String) The type of dataset/datasource. Usually 'table' for datasets. Defaults to `table`.
- `description` (String) A description of the chart's purpose.
- `params` (String) JSON string containing chart parameters and configuration. These are generated by Superset's chart builder and control the chart's appearance and behavior.
- `viz_type` (String) The type of chart visualization (e.g., 'table', 'pie', 'bar', 'line', 'big_number', etc.). Defaults to `table`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the chart.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Chart can be imported by specifying the numeric identifier of the Chart id
terraform import superset_chart.example 123
```
